## 3. Eri's wanted painting and an actual limit on adult questioning

004's museum tour supplies Eri's chosen art interests: dome beauty, claimed golden ratio and revolutionary history, plus the painting 創世の影像 depicting ghosts running toward sunset. The historical/technical judgments are her explanations, not an independent architectural measurement. Her wish to make an original, enduring school-representative painting has intrinsic analytical value. Teacher offers future viewing; that painting is not completed merely by an encouraging reply (004s002:u0003–0018).

Her claim that art originates with the occult combines cultural interest with causal inference. The forbidden tower's nameless bell, statue pointing toward it, full-moon circle legend, crying sculpture, tilting portrait, self-playing piano and moving demon statue are differently graded anecdotes/interpretations. Rena explicitly calls much of this urban legend. These accounts are not one scientifically or ontologically validated mechanism (004s002:u0019–0035).

Painting classmates actually greet Eri, want more company outside class and propose a tea gathering. Eri stammers, tries divination for an answer and says the problem is hers rather than the kind peers'. Teacher considers that there may be circumstances and explicitly stops pressing. Neither bullying by these classmates nor a clinical diagnosis is supplied. The future tea party is not actually held. Her difficulty in comparison with peers later receives her own explanation, while this respected question boundary remains a positive adult act (004s002:u0037–0059).

Tsumugi says no special origin made her occult-minded: time with friends is sufficient, as in her band. Kanoe says she simply likes it and liking needs no reason; more enjoyment helps in a dark world. Her good grades remain her report. Those explicit motives are intrinsically eligible even if low stakes. They should not be reduced to instrumental prerequisites for Eri's recognized work (007:u0018–0029).

Eri explains practical-test nerves and lost confidence after entering among more able artists. She calls herself a failure and says she has not made work she accepts. These self-evaluations are not a total objective ranking of every artwork. Her occult search aims to gain ability and stand confidently before friends. Teacher supports her dream in inwardly labelled lines that Eri appears to respond to. Rena maintains disbelief and the need to see for herself; Teacher also acknowledges reason's importance in an actual choice. Encouraging aspiration does not require the analyst to endorse a magical mechanism (007:u0030–0048).

Rena's own declared dream is to become Kivotos's best fashion designer; Tsumugi wants continued days together. Kanoe initially protects her secret dream, then reports a former-life bond. No past life, historical person or reciprocal prior relationship is verified by her claim. Milia interrupts their convivial conversation, warns that next time she will report to the Council and actually releases them with a caution. Milia's last line recognizes Teacher as a reunion, leaving its meaning until the later disclosure rather than automatically repairing her identity from a familiar role (007:u0077–0086).
## 7. Retained old paintings and joint cleanup precede another chosen risk

008 narrates shared work and continued cleaning. Covered old canvases are actually present. Kanoe asks Teacher not to look and explains that Eri keeps them to reflect on her path despite pain, calling her hardworking. Eri later says the room is restored; the printed endpoint supports local cleanup/restoration, not a separately inspected all-damages settlement (008:u0001–0025).

Kanoe proposes outside as safer, Tsumugi notes surveillance, and Eri divines causes. Firepower becomes an abstract interpretation after dangerous literal joking. Teacher chooses cards, Rena's comparison prompts Eri's new reading, and the old full-moon circle is proposed. These are deliberative contributions and interpretations, not a blind prophet whose forecast has independent proof. Rena asks Teacher to stop them. Teacher inwardly wants to help within limits; the peers invoke mutual dreams and promise no burden. Rena says she will not assist but joins the information visit to monitor them. Monitoring is not assent to occult belief (008:u0026–0087).

The search actually fails at first. Eri later changes from present facilities to founding-period buildings and reports a symmetric numeric 魔方陣 with six lines summing26. ## 8. Rena actually withdraws and her difference is respected

009 weighs real risk. Kanoe offers to act as decoy with animals; Eri asks Teacher, who agrees to help but says to avoid danger. The name ヴァルプルギスの夜 and full moon are their operation's art/ritual vocabulary, not a universal supernatural calendar. Teacher returns to Schale before the next-day transaction, so her secret does not become adult prior knowledge (009:u0001–0034).

Rena says she does not dislike the seniors and often enjoys their company, but refuses this specific dangerous operation. She offers that there are other enjoyable things, proposes an apotropaic origin rather than functioning magic, and explicitly steps off. This is an actual boundary, not merely a hint that she will eventually be persuaded (009:u0079–0107).010 confirms her absence and reported plan to sleep elsewhere. Tsumugi acknowledges genuine danger and says forcing someone else's belief does not advance art; recognizing differing sensibility matters. ## 9. Actual illumination and recognition do not validate summoning

010 supplies LEDs and phosphorescent tape rather than a new explosive material; Kanoe says the lights are remotely signalled. Teacher agrees these materials are safe locally, not that the unauthorized operation has no risk. They actually work around the school. A guard catches Teacher; Teacher's garden-illumination excuse is not a filed authorization. The Guard confirms no notified activity. A crow drops the contradictory special-rules text, distracting a guard with the reported secret666 line; Teacher escapes when attention shifts. A later005 voice's identity does not follow just from this actual crow action (010:u0026–0048).

011 shows Teacher rejoining, all cornered and the last lodging segment unfinished. Kanoe acknowledges tighter-than-expected guard, while Tsumugi's challenge rhetoric values persistence without proving guaranteed success. A bell rings from the nameless tower.012 gives Tsumugi's interpretation of a caring friend's guilt and resolve, then directly presents Rena at the tower angrily insisting the seniors succeed. The crows frighten guards, Kanoe proposes breaking through and Eri reaches for Teacher's hand (011;012s001/s002).

013 shows the lodging segment completed, lights activated and initially disappointed Eri. Guards first pretend loss of strength, then explicitly acknowledge it was just lights and they were playing along. No paralysis, mana drain, demon arrival or wish-granting physical mechanism is demonstrated. Tsumugi calls the lit campus beautiful and interprets passionate girls as jewels and light craft. This positive aesthetic account is neither an excuse to erase the Guard's lost sleep and morning work nor a proof every recipient shares the same taste (013:u0002–0032).

Milia relays the Council chair's message naming 雲類鷲マナミ. This is a represented mediated message, not physical on-site attendance or performed-voice receiving. The chair praises connecting past and present as unprecedented avant-garde art, wants continued named display and proposes a viewpoint and later formal visit. These institutional praise/intentions are stronger than private reassurance, but an actual constructed viewpoint, permanent exhibit, acquired photograph/collection item or future visit is not printed. Guards admit beauty and reluctance to remove it; art recognition does not itself cancel rules (013:u0034–0058).

Eri acknowledges wanting recognition, hiding impatience under confident laughter and owing the work to everyone. Teacher's inward reassurance values her own effort as well. Her renewed confidence and felt possibility are actual stated responses, not universal ability, a completed individual painting comparable in every respect to 創世の影像 or permanent recovery from every practical-test difficulty. Her inward wish for continued magic-like days reinterprets magic as jointly enabled ordinary possibility without retrospectively proving divination (013:u0059–0074).
## 10. The epilogue retains punishment, dissent and prospective access

014 locates Teacher and the group in the reflection room again. Rena says she turned herself in for forbidden tower entry and ringing. The successful artwork therefore does not produce complete exoneration or consequence-free recognition. Eri asserts wish-granting magic; Rena limits fulfilled wishes to Eri. Tsumugi reports new melody/lyrics arising during the chase and asks to perform; Rena declines preferring calm Tsumugi, whose reply teasingly makes that general affection. The mental melody is not a recorded/performed song, completed competitive concert or verified victory (014:u0001–0020).

Kanoe's new former-life certainty now identifies Rena as a beloved cat, whereas008 used Teacher as the supposed partner to hide another conversation. These context-dependent claims and Rena's objections defeat a literal soul/person merger. Eri credits Rena's help. Calling Rena's desire to enjoy company fulfilled meets her refusal, while reports that she reads astrology, observes an alchemy pot and asks about tarot show interest as reported by friends, not total supernatural belief or consent to every activity (014:u0021–0051).

They plan another work and a visit to the Council chair's private museum. Its secrecy, exclusive access and even the benevolent phantom thief's inability to enter are Kanoe/Tsumugi's accounts. Teacher is also curious but proposes trying ordinary access first and promises effort for students' entry. That request is not yet made/granted. Kanoe volunteers irregular means; Rena objects again. The narrator leaves next success open. Milia finally identifies herself locally both as a Guard executive and 慈愛の怪盗, anticipates another meeting and says she does not know its performance. This source-local dual claim matters without silently joining a canonical persona/variant to Akira or completing every identity inquiry (014:u0052–0085).
